import subprocess,sys,json,time,resource
# build a request with the worst-case stage + lots of events
import itertools
names=['S%d'%i for i in range(16)]
svcs=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
words=[]
for i in range(4090):
    words.append([names[i%16], names[(i//16)%16], names[(i//256)%16]] + [names[1+((i//4090)%14)]]*13)
pol=('contains(S0) allow; startswith(S1) drop; endswith(S2,S3) drop;'+''.join('match(%s) drop;'%','.join(w) for w in words))
ev=[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':pol},{'op':'commit','epoch':1},{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'S0'},
    {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,2,1],'service':'S1'},{'op':'open','connection':[1,1]}]
rid=0
while len(ev)<199995:
    rid+=1
    ev.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
    ev.append({'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid,'connection':[1,1],'stream':rid,'destination':'S1'})
    ev.append({'op':'recv','connection':[1,1],'stream':rid,'unit':[0,2,1],'rid':rid,'wire':None})
    ev.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
    ev.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':rid})
    if rid%50==0: ev.append({'op':'inspect'})
ev=ev[:200000]
data=json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':svcs,'limits':LIM,'events':ev}]}).encode()
print('input', len(data)/1e6,'MB')
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'launch.py'],input=data,capture_output=True)
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall',round(time.time()-t,2),'out',len(p.stdout)/1e6,'MB',p.stderr[:200])
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN); print('maxrss MB', round(u.ru_maxrss/1024,1))
"
